responsibility: Defines regression tests for the shell-style foreign format parser and translator, validating detection of dollar-sign escapes, parsing of ordinal and named substitutions with positions, iteration over substitutions in larger strings, and translation of supported shell placeholders into Rust format placeholders.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` is the shell-format test suite: it checks `$`/`$$` parsing, ordinal and named shell substitutions, and their direct translation to Rust placeholders, unlike `printf/tests.rs`, which validates the richer `printf` grammar with `%` specifiers, flags, widths, precisions, and length modifiers.
